name: neon-soup
description: Peer-to-peer execution layer for Cardano DeFi with a deep exploration for cypherpunk values

scripts.build: pnpm run build:intents && pnpm run build:devtool && pnpm run build:frontend
scripts.build:intents: pnpm run build:open && pnpm run build:close && pnpm run build:swap
scripts.test:swap-quote: pnpm run test:core-boundaries && tsc -p ./src/devtool/tsconfig.tests.json && node /tmp/neonsoup-devtool-tests/devtool/tests/swapQuote.test.js && node /tmp/neonsoup-devtool-tests/devtool/tests/cartReconciliation.test.js && node /tmp/neonsoup-devtool-tests/devtool/tests/coreIntentCartReceipt.test.js
scripts.dev: nodemon --watch src/ --ext gcscript,json,jsonc,hl,txt --ignore examples/ --exec "pnpm run build && pnpm run serve"
scripts.serve:autogen: pnpm run prepare:autogen && gamechanger-cli preprod snippet react -v 2 -S -o ./dist/autogen.html -f ./dist/intents/open.gcscript.json --snippetArgsFile ./config/snippet-args.json
